title: HITL & MFA: agent transfer to human approval
lede: The agent attempts a transfer; the mock policy decides by amount band or agent context — PERMIT, human consent (HITL), MFA step-up, CIBA out-of-band approval, or DENY — and the call proceeds only when the right human receipt is presented. Mock only.

nodes.label: Transfer gate: amount bands + agent context

steps.title: Agent attempts the transfer
steps.what: The agent calls create_transfer with an amount — the policy evaluates it against the bands and the agent context.

steps.title: The band decides the gate
steps.what: Below the confirm bar it permits; the confirm band returns HITL_CONSENT; the MFA band returns STEP_UP (which outranks consent); above the ceiling it denies outright.

steps.title: CIBA for agent-context actions
steps.what: For a sensitive agent-initiated action the policy requests out-of-band approval regardless of amount: bc-authorize, the user approves on the phone, the agent polls.

steps.title: The human decides
steps.what: Consent modal, device OTP, or the phone: each path ends in a receipt — single-use, amount-bound, the MFA credit with a five-minute TTL.

steps.title: Receipt presented, transfer executes
steps.what: Only the right receipt lets the retried call through — consumed on use, so it can never approve a second transfer.
